main_text.p: ὀλίγα. Eximunt, inquit, ex uno apum alueari choemvnum, aut vnum cum dimidio.vel,bene vt agatur,choas binos, aut binos cum dimidio : raro ternos choas. Eat nunc iste opicus, & dicat πέντε ἡμίχοα εἶναι τέτταρα ἢ ἥμισυ[?]. Abfit vero à nobis, vt hæc & alia huius farinæ, qualia nonnulla in illis fcholiis obferuaui-mus, Vlpiano tribuamus.

τῆς ἡμέρας προσπράξεσθαι[?].) Atticum est, ἀντὶ τοῦ εἰσπράξεσθαι[?]. non aliter fere Demosthenes caeteri-que fcriptores de meliore nota. non ergo funt audiendi qui εἰσπράξεσθαι iubent refcribi. Veteres & Græci & Latini sæpe eleganter fimplicibus verbis pro compofitis vtuntur : fic ergo πράσσω aliàs pro ἐμπράσσω, exigo : pro συμπράσσω. Pindarus Nemeonicis Πράσσει γὰρ ἔργῳ μὲν [?] βελτίων ἢ φράσει[?]. hoc eft, συμπράσσει, σωτηρεῖ. Notabis pactionem de vfura in fingulos dies : cuius extat etiam in Epidico Plauti exemplum.

p.i: Id adeo argentum ab danista apud Thebas fœnore:
In dies minafque argenti fingulas, nummis.

main_text.p: Qui hanc vsuram exercebant, Græci eos ἡμερησί[?]ς vocabant, vt Laertius in Menippo.
Res hodie tocullionibus præsertim Iudæis non incognita.

καὶ τὰς ὥρας διὰ τὴν ἐμπολήματος εἰς τὸ ἀ[?]ν ἐν ἐν.] Iam venimus ad locum longè elegantissimum, & ex iis vnum qui vetustatem libelli huius arguunt : cuius veram interpretationem prioribus interpretibus ne per fomnium quidem in mentem veniffe affirmare aufim : eft enim & obscurior propter ignorationem prifcorum morum:& nonnihil etiam

page.notes: Greek passages are partly faint at the outer edge; the Greek words marked [?] and the ending of the Pindar quotation are doubtful. The bracket after "ἐν ἐν." is printed as shown. "danista" is a doubtful reading (possibly "danista" with a smudged letter). The page has no margin notes. The word "etiam" at the foot is the catchword and is not repeated in the text. Printing errors are left as they are: "choem-" is a line-end hyphen, and the opening word of the page is a fragment, so the paragraph is marked cont="true".
